task.title: How to Generate and Send PHA Payment Standards Report

user_message.content: Run the PHA payment standards daily email report for Apartment Corp. Execute the Python script at /home/ubuntu/pha_email_report.py to generate the HTML report and detect any changes from the previous day's snapshot at /home/ubuntu/pha_snapshot.json. Then send the resulting HTML from /home/ubuntu/pha_email_preview.html via Gmail to both brandon@apartmentcorp.com AND mam@22.bz with the subject "[Apartment Corp] Section 8 PHA Payment Standards Report — {today's date}". The content field should be the full HTML string. The email should include all 43 properties, portfolio KPI stats (1BR/2BR/3BR/4BR averages), a changes section (or "No Changes" if none), regional summary, and the full property table with color-coded payment tiers.

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request
